prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration, the scene unfolds within a chaotic yet organized restaurant kitchen. On the far left stands a chef with spiky blue hair wearing a pristine white uniform, actively chopping vegetables on a wooden board. Next to him, a sous-chef with short black hair and glasses observes the cutting technique intently. In the center foreground, a large stainless steel pot sits on a burner, emitting visible steam that curls upward into the air. A line cook with a red bandana tied around their forehead leans over the pot, stirring its contents with a long ladle. To the right of the stove, a waiter in a crisp black vest holds a silver tray steady, waiting for the dish to be plated. Behind the waiter, a dishwasher with wet sleeves rolled up scrubs a stack of white plates vigorously. Perched on a high shelf above the dishwasher is a small orange cat watching the commotion below with wide eyes. Near the back wall, a manager in a sharp grey suit points toward the exit door, signaling urgency to a delivery person in a yellow jacket who is checking a clipboard. The delivery person stands next to a tall stack of cardboard boxes filled with supplies. In the lower right corner, a busboy with messy brown hair sweeps the floor with a broom, kicking up small dust motes. A female server with long blonde hair tied in a ponytail hands a finished plate to the waiter in the black vest. The chef with spiky blue hair looks at the line cook with the red bandana, ensuring the timing is perfect. The small orange cat sits on the shelf directly above the dishwasher with wet sleeves. There is no window showing the outside world, keeping the focus entirely on the interior labor. There is no digital clock on the wall, relying instead on the natural rhythm of the kitchen staff.
